title: 2026 Holiday Tree Trail
seo_title: 2026 Holiday Tree Trail in Joplin, MO on Dec 3
description: The Holiday Tree Trail features Christmas trees decorated by local organizations and businesses, and visitors can vote for their favorite tree. There is also hot chocolate, a visit from Santa Claus, and music and dancing. It takes place Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at 3002 Saint Johns Blvd in Joplin, MO.
